[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Bythen Forral''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] veteran of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] who moved from flying fighters to teaching the next generation of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] cadets. He taught at [[Vensenor Flight Academy/Legends|Vensenor Flight Academy]] and was known to encourage nonstandard solutions to problems. He had the largest amount of students defect to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], but was not an active supporter of the Rebellion.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />

The Vensenor Academy allowed him to use a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|Corellian corvette]] known as the [[Gallant/Legends|''Gallant'']], as long as he used it for at least three months every year to tour the Empire and train recruit new cadets.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
